extension.news:
3.0.1.1 - Artwork: new add-on icon. No code change. - This is the bump the 3.0.1 note below said the next change would need. A content change that reused 3.0.1 would be invisible to Kodi, which compares add-ons by id and version: a box would silently keep the old build and the old icon, with no error and no symptom. - The number is our FIRST revision on top of upstream 3.0.1, which is why it reads 3.0.1.1 and not 3.0.2. The 3.0.1 prefix still states the provenance the way the note below intended, and 3.0.2 stays free to mean a future re-fork from upstream's own 3.0.2. Nothing here can collide with upstream: the id is ours and they never publish under it. - Supersedes one claim below: this add-on IS now offered by a repository, the Tony.7.Bones repository, so a box resolves it as an ordinary dependency rather than needing a zip installed by hand.
3.0.1 - Renumbered from 1.1.0. This add-on now carries the version of the upstream build it was forked from, so the number itself states the provenance: it is Skin Shortcuts 3.0.1 with the changes listed below on top. Nothing else changed in this step; the code is what was released as 1.1.0. - Sharing a version number with the official add-on is safe and cannot lead to either one replacing the other. Kodi identifies, resolves and compares add-ons by their id, and this add-on's id is its own. The official build is never consulted for an update to this one, and this one is offered by no repository at all. - Consequence worth knowing: because the version now matches upstream's, two different builds of THIS add-on must not both be labelled 3.0.1. The next change to the code needs a number above it.
Changes below were first released as 1.1.0. - Fix: browsing into a widget no longer asks which type it is when the answer is already known. A type the skin declared is honoured, as upstream's own widgets.md shows it being declared (type="movies" browse="true"), and otherwise the type is inferred from the browsed path. Cancelling that prompt used to discard the whole selection and drop the user back at the start of the picker, which is the loop this removes. - Fix: a plugin add-on resolved from content source="addons" no longer claims the content-source target as its widget type. That produced widgetType "video", which is a target rather than a type and matches no skin condition. - Add: pathLabel beside path on every menu item, a readable rendering of the content path, so a skin can show "Movies / Titles" or an add-on's own name instead of videodb://movies/titles/
Changes below were first released as 1.0.0. - Fork of Skin Shortcuts 3.0.1 by MikeSiLVO, under a separate add-on id so it never collides with, outranks or is overwritten by the official build. Licence and authorship are unchanged; see ATTRIBUTION.md. - Fix: the management dialog's Change action button (control 307) opens the shortcut picker instead of a bare keyboard, falling back to manual entry only when the skin declares no groupings - Add: menus, widgets and per-item data are adopted once from an existing Skin Shortcuts profile, so an already configured box keeps its Home menu
